newsitem.title: FRANCE: Third night of gypsy protests in French town.
newsitem.headline: Third night of gypsy protests in French town.

text.p: Masked gypsies wielding iron bars burned tyres and barricaded roads on Monday in a third night of protests in the western French city of Nantes against the police killing of two gypsies during an attempted robbery last week, witnesses said.
The gypsies, backed by a few men with shotguns, placed trucks across the main ring-road around Nantes and dumped the contents on the road.

The protesters say the two dead men were shot in cold blood last Wednesday, when police caught eight men robbing a tool warehouse. Police said the thieves fired on them first, wounding a policeman in the leg, before they shot back.
Spokesmen for the gypsy community said none of the eight had any firearms. A ballistics report on the injured policeman's wounds published on Monday supported the police version.
